title: Server exposes 14 tools, exceeding the spec's query set
evidence: src/brsoccer/server.clj:79 `tools` vector — search_matches, head_to_head, team_stats, standings, rank_teams, competition_stats, biggest_wins, team_competitions, derbies, search_players, player_details, brazilian_club_squads, team_profile, list_competitions
suggestion: None — extras (derbies, team_profile, biggest_wins) are beyond spec and welcome

title: Cross-file fixture de-duplication merges the same match across CSVs
evidence: src/brsoccer/data.clj:191 merge-duplicates collapses ~23,954 rows to ~16,750 matches by (competition, home, away) within a 3-day window; prevents double-counting in statistics
suggestion: None — improves correctness of aggregate stats (R10)

title: FIFA player file lacks squads for major Brazilian clubs
evidence: README.md documents that fifa_data.csv has no Flamengo/Palmeiras/Corinthians/São Paulo squads and included Brazilian clubs carry placeholder names; a data limitation, not a code defect. Player search (R7/R8) still functions over the data present.
suggestion: None actionable in code — dataset limitation, already disclosed in README

title: Standings omit tribunal point deductions and gate champion on completeness
evidence: src/brsoccer/query.clj:162 standings — champion/relegation only named when >= (n*(n-1))-2 matches present; 2023 (3 matches short) shows table without champion. Points deducted by sporting courts are not in the data.
suggestion: None — honest handling of incomplete/unofficial data (R9)
